name: Windmill valley

categories.label: VP on track before final scoring
categories.labelVi: VP trên track trước khi tính điểm cuối
categories.hint: All VP gained during the game including the extra last turn.

categories.label: Contracts on Farm board
categories.hint: Score each of your Contracts individually (appendix pp.15-17); enter the sum.

categories.label: Empty Windmill groups
categories.hint: Count Tulip Bulbs in your Patches per color for each EMPTY Windmill Group only (enter 0 for colors whose group is not empty).

categories.label: Complete Patch rows
categories.hint: Each complete row scores its higher value if all bulbs share one color, otherwise the lower value. Enter the sum.

categories.label: Complete Patch columns (negative penalties allowed)
categories.labelVi: Cột Patch hoàn chỉnh (cho phép điểm phạt)
categories.hint: Complete column with all different colors scores the printed number; any same-colored bulbs in a column (complete or not) lose the indicated VP. Enter net total.

categories.label: Tulip Bulbs in Patches (tiebreaker)
categories.labelVi: Số củ tulip trong Patches (hòa điểm)

categories.label: Tulip Bulbs in Storage (tiebreaker)
categories.labelVi: Số củ tulip trong kho (hòa điểm)

categories.label: Windmills on Main board (tiebreaker)
categories.labelVi: Số Windmill trên bàn chính (hòa điểm)

tiebreakers.description: Most Windmills on the Main board
If still tied, players share the victory.

notes: family: point-salad-euro. Game end triggers when a player reaches the end of the Calendar; finish the round, everyone plays one more turn, then final scoring (Contracts, empty Windmill groups, complete rows/columns of Patches). Expert variant skips the extra turn. Promo/expansion modules and solo mode not modelled.
